text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU backlog growth detected in us-west2 spot-pool A. queue_size > 12k across p3/p4 instance groups, autoscaler failing to add capacity (scale_attempts=5, limit=8). Preemptible interruption rate spike at 47%.
Ana (oncall): paging... taking this.
Ana (oncall): digging into autoscaler logs now, attaching logs to thread.
Raj (infra): seeing API 429s from cloud provider during scaling requests. provisioning failures look like quota/soft-limit throttling.
Sally (eng-runtime): queue latency > 1.2s/token, token throttle kicking in, clients seeing 503s and slow streams. Which customers are hit?
Emily (support): support queue shows increased error reports from two large customers in us-west2 (acct-redwood-42, acct-botlabs). Marking P2-P1 escalations.
Tom (sre): allocation attempts show many nodes preempted immediately after launch. Seems like spot churn + provider-side capacity denial.
Ana (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) disable spot pool autoscale for new allocations 2) route new requests to dedicated-pool-usw2-1 3) ramp down non-critical batch jobs.
Sally (eng-runtime): can we flip routing quickly? I can push a policy change to route 25% traffic to dedicated pool and 75% to remaining spot until stable. Need deploy approval.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: change-route-policy -> canary -> awaiting confirmation from Ana.
Ana (oncall): approve canary. deploy-bot: starting rollout.
Raj (infra): opening cloud support ticket, request expedited quota bump and explanation for provisioning failures. Ticket #CLOUD-2701.
Tom (sre): running drain of low-priority jobs from inference-queue-batch-*. Command:
```
# evict low-priority
kubectl label evict=true inference-job --selector=priority=batch
kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/batch-worker-*
```
Tom (sre): also increasing max_nodes on dedicated pool to absorb load, manual scale to +12 nodes in progress.
Sally (eng-runtime): enabling aggressive KV prefix caching for chat routes to reduce token compute. Deploying config change to 60s cache TTL.
Emily (support): posting interim customer status in support channels, noting degraded performance and active mitigation.
Ana (oncall): observed immediate drop in queue growth after canary routing shift. queue_size down from 12.4k -> 6.8k in 6m. Latency improving but still above SLOs.
incident-bot: system note: canary rollout succeeded on 10% -> 25% -> 50% steps. No errors during rollout.
Raj (infra): cloud support responded: "We observed transient capacity pressure in us-west2 influence by cyclical maintenance + high spot reclamation. No hard quota; recommend switching to on-demand or reserved pools as fallback."
Sally (eng-runtime): proposing permanent fallback rule: if spot preempt rate > 25% for >2min AND queue_growth_rate > 200r/s, auto-shift X% to dedicated for 15m. Raise to product for approval.
Tom (sre): we should also add a circuit-breaker to prevent autoscaler from thrashing when provisioning failures occur. Suggested: backoff window = 5m after 3 failed scale attempts.
Ana (oncall): on-call handoff at +45. I'll summarize for next on-call.
Emily (support): customers notified: ticket updates sent at T+12m, T+25m. No data exfiltration. Impact: increased latency and intermittent 503s for requests routed to spot.
Sally (eng-runtime): small log snippet showing throttles:
```
[2026-06-14T15:12:03Z] WARN scale: failed provision attempt=4 err="quota exceeded" provider=cloudusw2
[2026-06-14T15:12:09Z] INFO fallback: routing 25% -> dedicated-pool-usw2-1
[2026-06-14T15:18:12Z] ERROR preempt: instance-id=i-0a12 preempted, reclaim=true
```
Tom (sre): mitigation status: manual dedicated scale +12 nodes completed. Batch evictions freed ~800 GPUs worth of queued work (approx).
Ana (oncall): status at handoff: queue_size 3.1k, token_latency trending to SLO but still 15% over target on heavy chat routes. Route policy at 60% dedicated / 40% spot. Autoscaler disabled for spot pools temporarily.
Ana (oncall): next steps for incoming on-call: 1) monitor queue and latency dashboards 2) keep cloud ticket open and escalate if provisioning errors resume 3) prepare to convert to full dedicated overflow if preemption resumes 4) follow up with product on fallback policy change.
Raj (infra): cloud ticket update: provider accepted follow-up and will prioritize region. We also requested a post-incident capacity report.
Sally (eng-runtime): will open a short post-incident eval to measure per-route quality delta from caching + routing shift.
Emily (support): creating consolidated customer-facing incident summary to send at next update window.
Tom (sre): recording incident runbook deviations: manual scale, disable autoscale, batch eviction. Will add these as temporary runbook appendices.
Ana (oncall): handing off to Raj for night shift. Summary: high spot preemptions + autoscaler thrash -> queue growth and throttling; mitigated by routing to dedicated + manual scale + batch evictions; customer impact: latency + intermittent 503s to some customers; cloud ticket open.
Raj (infra): taking handoff. I'll keep the dedicated pool at +12 until morning. Ping me if queue > 4k or preempt_rate > 30%.
incident-bot: incident annotated as active -> mitigated. created incident record: INC-2026-0614-08.
Ana (oncall): thanks team — great quick coordination. :heart:
Emily (support): will coordinate postmortem comms with product and account teams.
Sally (eng-runtime): filing follow-ups: fallbacks RFC, autoscaler backoff patch, more aggressive caching heuristics.
Tom (sre): adding action item: run stress test on spot churn simulation and validate circuit-breaker.
Raj (infra): closing handoff. Leaving ticket CLOUD-2701 assigned to infra.
Ana (oncall): last check-in, queue stable 2.9k, latency 8% over SLO. Marking thread for postmortem draft.
